svg.title: Mockup 06: stack health (superadmin)
svg.text: 06 · Stack health: every part of the shared stack, platform incidents, and a guarded restart (superadmin)
On the superadmin hostname only (Tailscale). The event's Health shows one word for all this; here are the parts, their versions and what a restart would touch.
Use case: the superadmin sees that a shared part is slow, reads its last lines, and restarts it knowing which live events it touches
A · Stack health at 1280 px: one part slow, two events live
14 parts · 13 ok · 1 slow · all on v0.8.0 · 2 events live · deploy hold on
Its queue's oldest job is 14 min old.
by name; trouble shows on the card, never moves it

v0.8.0 · answers in 9 ms · up 3 d
v0.8.0 · answers in 7 ms · up 3 d
v0.8.0 · answers in 41 ms · up 3 d
v0.8.0 · answers in 12 ms · up 3 d
8 more parts, all ok: notify, pizza, tenants, theming, Postgres, Valkey, Caddy, ops
Takeover on air in Main hall
B · Restart, guarded: who it touches, typed to confirm
It serves every event. Slides being made start again; screens keep
Demo Event: a takeover is on air in Main hall
An automatic restart waits while a takeover is on (E8).
Type screen-render to restart it now
Runs through the ops sidecar, which may only restart, inspect and read
logs of the stack's parts. Audited with your name and the live events it
C · Stack on a phone over Tailscale
The superadmin's console wears a purple Platform mark and its
own menu, so it is never mistaken for an event (L8). One summary
line: parts, versions, live events and the deploy hold (0013 item
Platform incidents go to the platform guild's channel, never an
Parts are an 18 rem card grid in a fixed order (amendment 3); the
rest fold into one dashed line while they are ok.
No free-text commands anywhere: Restart and Logs are the only
two actions on a part (D10, D11).
